pages.title: TB Mukt Bharat — JOSH Teams launch and progress

facts.text: JOSH: Joint Squad for Health — launched nationally 8 October 2026, Bharat Mandapam, by Health Minister J.P. Nadda
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Ministries: Health, Youth Affairs & Sports, Defence
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Phase 1: 55 districts in 11 States; team = Class-I officers + MY Bharat volunteers + NCC cadets
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: AI chatbot "Khushi Avatar"; 2025: 67,933 panchayats in 697 districts declared TB Mukt
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: *Mycobacterium tuberculosis*; BCG vaccine; World TB Day 24 March (Koch, 1882)
facts.head: Background

facts.text: NTEP (formerly RNTCP); India target 2025 vs SDG 2030
facts.head: Background

facts.text: MY Bharat launched 31 October 2023; NCC est. 1948, motto "Unity and Discipline"
facts.head: Background

facts.text: New TB case rate 2015–2024: India −21% vs global −12%
facts.head: Progress

facts.text: Treatment coverage: India 92% vs global 78%
facts.head: Progress

facts.text: 28.1 crore tests; 20 lakh+ got TB Preventive Treatment; 5.7 lakh new Ni-kshay Mitras; 46,118 GPs certified TB-free; handheld X-ray screening up 34-fold
facts.head: Progress

facts.text: BPaLM regimen for drug-resistant TB — Bedaquiline, Pretomanid, Linezolid, Moxifloxacin
facts.head: Progress

facts.text: PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan launched 9 September 2022
facts.head: Progress

facts.text: ⚠ 8 Oct source: 67,933 panchayats TB Mukt in 2025; 15 Oct source: 46,118 GPs certified

pages.title: Lakshadweep — first UT with 100% literacy under ULLAS

facts.text: Declared 11 October 2026 by Administrator Praful Patel; all 1,113 identified illiterate adults passed FLNAT
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: ULLAS: Understanding of Lifelong Learning for All in Society (New India Literacy Programme) — CSS, 2022–23 to 2026–27, age 15+, target 5 crore; 95% = fully literate
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Lakshadweep: capital Kavaratti; UT 1 November 1956; smallest UT by area; International Literacy Day 8 September

pages.title: Kerala introduces India's first comprehensive Elderly Care Bill

facts.text: Kerala — first State with a dedicated comprehensive elderly care bill
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: Protection from abuse, neglect, illegal property occupation; mandatory registration of old-age homes; jail and fines
facts.head: Key facts

facts.text: MWPSC Act 2007 — senior citizen 60+; Sec 23 property transfer void; Article 41; International Day of Older Persons 1 October
facts.head: Key facts
